spans.s:
लिम्प m. (-म्पः) Smearing, anointing, plastering.
 E. लिप् to smear
(taking in its derivative forms the nasal augment,) and श aff.

लिम्पट m. (-टः) A lecher, a whore-monger.
 f. (-टा) Libidinous, lust-
ful.
 E. लिपि to smear with unguents, अटच् aff.; also लम्पट ।

लिम्पाक m. (-कः)
 1. The lime tree, (Citrus acida.) “पातिलेबुर गाछ ।”
2. An ass.
 E. लिपि to smear, aff. काकन् ।
